environment.description: Application deployed on RHEL 9 with podman in rootless mode. A custom SELinux type enforcement policy (myapp_webhook_t) is loaded that confines the process with: allow myapp_webhook_t myapp_secret_t:file { read open getattr }; allow myapp_webhook_t myapp_log_t:file { read open getattr append }; All other file access is denied by the SELinux policy. Additionally, the container runs with a seccomp profile that filters nanosleep/clock_nanosleep syscalls (returning EPERM), and the kernel is compiled with CONFIG_HRTIMER_RESOLUTION=1ms. The /admin/debug endpoint's ReadFile calls are constrained by the SELinux file context labels — only files labeled myapp_log_t are accessible.

config.selinux_policy: custom type enforcement: myapp_webhook_t domain, file contexts restricted to myapp_secret_t (for /etc/myapp/secrets/*) and myapp_log_t (for /var/log/myapp/*)
config.seccomp_profile: custom profile filtering clock_nanosleep and nanosleep syscalls with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO(EPERM)
config.kernel_config: CONFIG_HZ=100, CONFIG_HRTIMER_RESOLUTION not set (defaults to low-res)
config.network: Envoy sidecar with 100ms jitter injection on all responses
